task.title: Check Out a Branch
task.shortdesc: Check out an existing branch, create a new one from a commit, or inspect a commit in a detached HEAD.

context.p: You check out from the view, starting from a chosen commit.

step.cmd: Right-click a commit in the view and select .

info.p: When a single local branch points to the commit, you can double-click it to switch straight to that branch.

choices.choice: Switch to existing local branch — checks out a branch that already points to the commit.
Create a new branch — enter a Branch name and, optionally, set it to track a remote branch. The Git Client pre-fills a suggested name and tracking when it can.
Detached HEAD — checks out the commit without a branch, for a quick look.

result.note: An amber HEAD label marks the commit while you're in detached HEAD mode. Changes you make there are temporary — to keep them, create a branch before you switch away.
